id: \bStay away from my house. You just can't go in cause you want to!
en: \bStay away from my house. You just can't go in cause you want to!
it: \bStai lontano da casa mia. Non puoi entrare solo perché ti va!

id: \rI wish we would turn that mountain into something useful. We could build a headquarters on it or something.
en: \rI wish we would turn that mountain into something useful. We could build a headquarters on it or something.
it: \rVorrei che trasformassimo quella montagna in qualcosa di utile. Potremmo costruirci sopra un quartier generale o qualcosa del genere.
Capopalestra della Palestra Pokémon di Rupepoli:\nMaylene

id: \bThis city is striving to become the best. We have so much already.
en: \bThis city is striving to become the best. We have so much already.
it: \bQuesta città punta a diventare la migliore. Abbiamo già così tanto.

id: \bSaturn: Oh, someone decided to stand up to us?
en: \bSaturn: Oh, someone decided to stand up to us?
it: \bSaturno: Oh, qualcuno ha deciso di tenerci testa?

id: \bIt's too late. I've obtained the Spear Key and will be taking these meteorites as well.
en: \bIt's too late. I've obtained the Spear Key and will be taking these meteorites as well.
it: \bÈ troppo tardi. Ho ottenuto la Chiave Lancia e mi prenderò anche questi meteoriti.

id: \bSaturn: We will retreat for now. The Spear Key will point us to other areas of interest.
en: \bSaturn: We will retreat for now. The Spear Key will point us to other areas of interest.
it: \bSaturno: Per ora ci ritiriamo. La Chiave Lancia ci indicherà altri luoghi d'interesse.

id: \bI'm trying to work. Please don't bother me.
en: \bI'm trying to work. Please don't bother me.
it: \bSto cercando di lavorare. Non disturbarmi, per favore.

id: \bI think the machines are rigged. I can never win anything so they must be.
en: \bI think the machines are rigged. I can never win anything so they must be.
it: \bSecondo me le macchinette sono truccate. Non vinco mai niente, quindi devono esserlo per forza.

id: \bLook, this is important to me, okay?
en: \bLook, this is important to me, okay?

id: \bI should get out before it is too late.
en: \bI should get out before it is too late.
it: \bDovrei andarmene prima che sia troppo tardi.

id: \bHello there. Want my Abra to take you somewhere?
en: \bHello there. Want my Abra to take you somewhere?
it: \bSalve. Vuoi che il mio Abra ti porti da qualche parte?

id: \bPaul: Come for a rematch? Let's see what you've learned.
en: \bPaul: Come for a rematch? Let's see what you've learned.
it: \bPaul: Sei venuto per la rivincita? Vediamo cos'hai imparato.

id: \bPaul: I'm training myself to be able to beat Brandon. I need to get back to work.
en: \bPaul: I'm training myself to be able to beat Brandon. I need to get back to work.
it: \bPaul: Mi sto allenando per riuscire a battere Brandon. Devo tornare al lavoro.

id: \rYou want to challenge the gym? Haha, good luck. She is better than you would think.
en: \rYou want to challenge the gym? Haha, good luck.  She is better than you would think.
it: \rVuoi sfidare la Palestra? Ahah, buona fortuna. È più forte di quanto pensi.

id: Find what you need at the Veilstone Dept. Store!
en: Find what you need at the Veilstone Dept. Store!
it: Trova ciò che ti serve al Centro Commerciale di Rupepoli!

id: \bReggie is our local breeder. He can train even the most stubborn of personalities.
en: \bReggie is our local breeder. He can train even the most stubborn of personalities.
it: \bReggie è l'allevatore del posto. Riesce ad allenare anche i caratteri più testardi.

id: \bMaylene recently suffered a tough defeat to a Trainer named Paul. He said some pretty harsh things to her and she hasn't been normal since.
en: \bMaylene recently suffered a tough defeat to a Trainer named Paul. He said some pretty harsh things to her and she hasn't been normal since.
it: \bMaylene ha subito di recente una dura sconfitta da un Allenatore di nome Paul. Le ha detto cose piuttosto cattive e da allora non è più la stessa.

id: \bMaylene seems to be doing better now.
en: \bMaylene seems to be doing better now.

id: \rMy friend went on a journey some time ago. I hope they are doing okay.
en: \rMy friend went on a journey some time ago. I hope they are doing okay.
it: \rUna persona a me cara è partita per un viaggio tempo fa. Spero che stia bene.

id: \bI'm sorry but Maylene is not taking any challenges right now.
en: \bI'm sorry but Maylene is not taking any challenges right now.
it: \bMi dispiace, ma al momento Maylene non accetta sfide.

id: \rDawn: I was passing through and heard the Gym Leader was depressed because of her defeat to Paul.
en: \rDawn: I was passing through and heard the Gym Leader was depressed because of her defeat to Paul.
it: \rLucinda: Ero di passaggio e ho sentito che la Capopalestra era depressa per la sconfitta contro Paul.

id: \rI couldn't stand the thought of him hurting someone so I battled with her and cheered her up. No need to worry, she is doing great now.
en: \rI couldn't stand the thought of him hurting someone so I battled with her and cheered her up. No need to worry, she is doing great now.
it: \rNon sopportavo l'idea che lui ferisse qualcuno, così ho lottato con lei e l'ho tirata su di morale. Niente paura, ora sta benissimo.
